command:
docker run --rm \
  -v /Users/manyashetty/Desktop/test_tr/ds_tr:/data:ro \
  -v /Users/manyashetty/Desktop/test_tr/out_tr2:/out \
  -v /Users/manyashetty/Desktop/Agentic_fMRIPrep/license.txt:/opt/freesurfer/license.txt:ro \
  nipreps/fmriprep:25.2.3 \
  /data /out participant \
  --participant-label 01 \

  --nprocs 1 \

  -w /out/work
